approval_scope: Complete TaskFlow Group 14 decision record as presented

requirements.decision: Every required capability and quality gate maps to canonical requirements, typed architecture elements, implementation artifacts, and specific verification results.

Each required security and failure scenario has an explicit test, expected outcome, and evidence reference, including cross-workspace access, unauthorized role changes, invalid authentication, expired or revoked sessions, and duplicate idempotent effects.
Static inspection, unit tests, integration tests, contract tests, end-to-end tests, deployment smoke tests, and runtime observations remain distinct evidence types.
Fixtures, mock responses, declared capabilities, and simulated runtime results cannot satisfy a requirement that requires real execution.
Use PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, or NOT_RUN as appropriate. Missing evidence never becomes a pass by default.
Any failed required capability or negative-case test blocks certification; unresolved requirements remain explicit blockers.
Preserve canonical input and acceptance-suite hashes, test commands, relevant logs, artifact digests, and execution environment for each trial.
The evaluator checks generated artifacts against frozen acceptance criteria without giving the generator a golden implementation or its expected solution.
A passing mapping audit is necessary but insufficient: generation, deployment, and runtime claims require their own direct evidence.

notes: This record records approval expressed in chat only.
It is not a cryptographic signature or trusted evidence envelope.
Approval of verification requirements does not establish that tests have run or passed.
Certification remains blocked by unresolved implementation, evidence, and runtime gates.
